new_claim: The predecessor's global reference-L2 tail condition can be replaced by subcritical L2 complexity after any smaller positive amount of the same reference noise. Under hypercontractivity, sublinear Renyi complexity at one order r<2 suffices for a fixed target noise time; all fixed r<2 suffice for every fixed positive noise time.
strictness: A rare-spike Boolean family has vanishing polylogarithmic source LDA and is killed by every fixed positive noise level, while log ||Delta||_2^2 / D_n diverges; thus the old global L2 hypothesis is materially stronger than necessary.
mao_boundary: For Mao's product-null counterexample, survival of distinction at target time t forces positive interior smoothing complexity at every s<t: limsup log_+ ||T_s h_n||_2^2 / D_n >= 2(t-s). Hypercontractivity then forces a corresponding linear-in-D_n lower bound on Renyi divergence of order 1+e^{-2s}.
